cues.speaker: rim_echo
cues.text: You wake where the surf leaves you. Step off the wreck raft and follow the dry sand inland.

cues.speaker: hearth_guide
cues.text: Take the wreck rake first, then grab your bathing suit from the tide line. Do not face the hunger bare-handed.

cues.speaker: hearth_guide
cues.text: A hungry kin rushes the circle ahead. Break its charge, then strike while it reels.

cues.speaker: hearth_guide
cues.text: Turn the dark patch with your rake. A field only answers hands that open it.

cues.speaker: feather_bearer
cues.text: Seed to soil, breath to loam. If the grain remembers me, the hunger keeps its distance.

cues.speaker: hearth_guide
cues.text: Cut the ripe heads and gather them close. Food is the first wall any settlement raises.

cues.speaker: hearth_guide
cues.text: Raise the first hearth on the marked site. Three arms of wood are enough to begin a village.

cues.speaker: rim_echo
cues.text: Every shelter on the disc is a promise against the famine wind. Rest here, and the wider path will answer you.
